name: Necromancer´s Ruins
description:
About This Game

Necromancer's Ruins is a 2D roguelike platformer where you explore magical ruins, fight monsters, collect treasure, and slowly become stronger between runs.

You play as a young treasure hunter who sets out to find ancient relics hidden inside dangerous ruins. Each expedition takes you through rooms full of enemies, traps, rewards, upgrades, and powerful creatures waiting at the end.

You probably will not survive every run, but that is part of the journey. Return to the lobby, spend what you earned, unlock new upgrades, and try to go further next time.

The game is built around fast platforming, simple but satisfying combat, permanent progression, and a colorful hand-painted fantasy style.
short_desc: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.
